question: Where are a golf course located no farther than 190 kilometers toward the east of School of Cosmetology, Somerset, KY?
sql: SELECT P.park_name FROM parks AS P WHERE P.leisure = 'golf_course' AND ST_DWithin( P.geometry::geography, ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%School of Cosmetology%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Somerset%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%KY%' LIMIT 1 )::geography, 190000 -- 190 kilometers in meters ) AND degrees(ST_Azimuth( ( SELECT geometry FROM pois WHERE poi_name ILIKE '%School of Cosmetology%' AND addr_city ILIKE '%Somerset%' AND addr_state ILIKE '%KY%' LIMIT 1 ), P.geometry )) BETWEEN 67.5 AND 112.5;
